summary: CHANGELOG table is incomplete against brief F5: CONTEXT_OBJECT_CONFLICT (exit 1 to 2, name unchanged) has no row, so a script that waited for exit 1 from `context-pack add` on an object conflict is not told; the brief counts 20 codes that move 1 to 2 and the CHANGELOG headline says `Twenty-two`, with no list that adds up to either number. atip.codeexit.10 passes only because it greps one phrase of the CHANGELOG and skips CONTEXT_OBJECT_CONFLICT in the old-name check. Add the row, state the count the table supports, and make codeexit.10 compare every 1-to-2 row of the brief's table with the CHANGELOG.
